So it was for my protection, but his as well, because if he realizes one day his dad is in jail because his mom manipulated him into telling a dangerous story, that could really wreck him.

windows.label: Human Written
windows.text: It takes a village.

windows.label: Human Written
windows.text: The nuclear family, built on parents’ romance, can often be the worst arrangement for children. If there’s trouble in paradise, parents will try to protect the kids by hiding their tension. But the truth is, children absorb that unresolved tension and integrate it into their very being. In a community, romance is one bond among several, and adult stability for children doesn’t rise and fall with it.

windows.label: Human Written
windows.text: A breakup can expose things you genuinely couldn’t see while you were bonded. Look at what you contributed, but also try to understand whatever was true in your ex’s perspective, including the conflicts they were carrying inside themselves, rather than one-dimensionalizing them.

windows.label: AI-Generated
windows.text: On the other hand, therapy risks becoming endless processing if the whole horizon is still “how do I manage this wound better?” For me, spirituality opened a much larger horizon of what happiness and love could even mean, beyond conditions & life story.

windows.label: AI-Generated
windows.text: Some people can close their eyes, imagine a loving parent, and immediately feel the archetype. Others summon the voice of the person who shamed, controlled, ignored, or frightened them. Some feel nothing. The instruction “be your own loving parent” already assumes the capacity they are missing.

windows.label: AI-Generated
windows.text: “May you be happy” can feel like rewarding the behavior. I don’t have to force that wording. Wishing someone the capacity to love, find peace, and stop causing harm is not celebrating what they did. The same doorway can face inward: “May I be peaceful and free,” or a sincere wish for the younger self’s wellbeing.

windows.label: AI-Generated
windows.text: Don’t turn the sentence into a formula. “But I love you” can become dismissive when it means, “Therefore stop being angry.” The useful test is whether the love can remain alive, hear the anger, and take whatever is true in it seriously. Non-retaliation is one expression of love; it is not a colder substitute for love.

windows.label: AI-Generated
windows.text: Use “I love you” only when it is honest.

windows.label: AI-Generated
windows.text: Otherwise, use a sincere wish for wellbeing or a commitment to non-cruelty without pretending they feel the same.

windows.label: Human Written
windows.text: I used to preach Buddhist enlightenment a lot.

windows.label: Human Written
windows.text: Eventually I realized that most people chase spiritual freedom as a way to get above childhood trauma or character defects they don’t want to meet. That’s called spiritual bypassing.

windows.label: AI-Generated
windows.text: It produces a split personality: the spiritual identity loses awareness of the trauma while the buried material festers and runs the person from underneath.

windows.label: AI-Generated
windows.text: Plenty of seekers and gurus show the split too; I’ve written about the Dalai Lama as one example.

windows.label: Human Written
windows.text: I don’t think everybody needs the same depth of spiritual experience.

windows.label: Human Written
windows.text: Some people already have enough love, meaning, beauty, and belonging for the life they want and aren’t especially curious for more. But for somebody who feels that ordinary life and conditional love are radically insufficient, the question of whether something much deeper is possible can become central.

windows.label: Human Written
windows.text: For deeper somatic therapy, look into Shaking, tapping (Emotional Freedom Technique), EMDR, Brainspotting, Somatic Experiencing, Water Therapy, Massage, Energy Healing, or another bottom-up approach before direct inner-child dialogue becomes useful.

windows.label: AI-Generated
windows.text: These practices can lower the charge enough that protective parts aren’t managing a flooded nervous system while you ask the child to speak. But the order in which they’re used matters.

windows.text: If you weren’t well-loved as a child, “love your inner child” may sound like nonsense.

windows.label: Human Written
windows.text: You may sincerely want the best for the child, hug them in imagination, or miss them—and still feel none of the beautiful warmth people mean by love.

windows.text: Curiosity can be enough: “Other people say they have experienced a depth of love, freedom, peace, or connection that I have never experienced. I don’t know whether I believe their explanation.
